overview_description.description:
Founded in 2015 by Executive Producer Danny Rosenbloom (Psyop, Brand New School) and Creative Director Yann Mabille (The Mill, Mill+), INTERSTATE is a new and spirited inter-disciplinary director’s group, focused on exploring and implementing great ideas into exceptional experiences on any platform.

Each of our directors bring their unique expertise to the group. They complement and challenge each other through their work and each director is dedicated to providing creative leadership throughout the entire project. But while we take ownership of the creative process, we do not need to own its actual means of production. We nimbly adapt our process to suit the needs of our clients and are equally comfortable producing in-house or collaborating with other industry specialists. Either way, we are committed and responsible from concept through delivery. Our goal is simply to provide our clients with the best possible work.
